items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In ’82, a concert with Fred [Hersh?], Joey Baron, and Marc Johnson in Brussels.

ctx.x: No. Where were we? And then in those days… that’s 1962, I had become popular in Sweden with the guitar and whistle, you know. We should have something in the iPad that you can listen to me playing the guitar. Oh, I know. In ’82, a concert with Fred [Hersh?], Joey Baron, and Marc Johnson in Brussels. That’s the best that… because the arrangement, the recording, I have… Okay, we get to that… make a note that you should ask me about Bluesette.
